question: Compare coastal and inland facility contexts without presuming a distance-pressure-emission causal law

fields.name: latitude_deg
fields.requirements: EPSG:4326 or recorded native CRS

fields.name: longitude_deg
fields.requirements: Axis order and source CRS required

fields.name: site_elevation_m
fields.requirements: Vertical datum and source DEM/survey required

fields.name: sensor_height_agl_m
fields.requirements: Above ground; distinct from altitude

fields.name: distance_to_coast_m
fields.requirements: Nearest coastline segment; version/year/datum/estuary and island rule required

fields.name: coastal_group
fields.requirements: Threshold preregistered after source feasibility; no default classification

fields.name: station_pressure_pa
fields.requirements: Actual station pressure; not sea-level adjusted

fields.name: sea_level_pressure_pa
fields.requirements: Never substitute for actual gas-law pressure

fields.name: pressure_tendency_pa_per_h
fields.requirements: Window, smoothing and lag preregistered; derived from station pressure

fields.name: cover_or_collection_pressure_difference_pa
fields.requirements: Reference pressure, sign convention and extraction state required

fields.name: temperature_k
fields.requirements: Sensor location and averaging required

fields.name: water_vapour_partial_pressure_pa
fields.requirements: Must align with gas sample

fields.name: wind_speed_m_per_s
fields.requirements: Height and reference frame required

fields.name: wind_direction_deg
fields.requirements: Meteorological from-direction; no ambiguous convention

fields.name: boundary_layer_stability
fields.requirements: Measured or validated derived method and limitations

fields.name: sea_breeze_event
fields.requirements: Independent criteria; onshore wind alone insufficient

fields.name: terrain_slope_aspect_valley
fields.requirements: DEM version/grid/vertical datum and derivation required

fields.name: landfill_waste_history_and_composition
fields.requirements: Mass units, time and waste categories required

fields.name: cover_condition_and_collection_state
fields.requirements: Cover moisture and gas recovery/negative-pressure operation

fields.name: wastewater_load_and_process
fields.requirements: Separate wastewater cohort; load, flow and treatment method

fields.name: ch4_dry_mole_fraction_ppb
fields.requirements: Background and calibration required; not emissions

fields.name: ch4_mass_concentration_mg_per_m3
fields.requirements: Actual or reference pressure/temperature and dry/wet basis required

fields.name: ch4_emission_rate_kg_per_h
fields.requirements: Flux/mass-balance/validated inverse method and uncertainty required

comparison_design.within_site: Multiple independent rising/falling pressure and independently identified sea-breeze events; geography constant within site
comparison_design.between_site: Multiple comparable facilities; match/stratify waste/process/age/collection/load/season; check common support
comparison_design.distance_primary: Continuous; no unapproved numeric coastal threshold
comparison_design.causal_target: Declare overall geographic comparison vs pressure/transport mechanism before choosing adjustment variables
comparison_design.validation: Hold out whole sites and weather events; assess serial/spatial dependence and measurement uncertainty
comparison_design.landfill_vs_wastewater: Separate cohorts and process models; do not pool facility types as exchangeable

existing_pr136_points: Context only; not a coastal-inland emissions cohort; no distance/elevation/group assigned
